title: Gender-tuning: Empowering Fine-tuning for Debiasing Pre-trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to measure bias scores by comparing the cosine similarity of sentence-level representations between gendered attribute word sets (e.g., male/female names and terms) and target concept word sets (e.g., career/family, math/art, and science/art).
